parameters.formDescription: Upload your Primavera P6 XER or XML schedule file. Our AI will analyze it for critical path issues, missing logic, open-ended activities, negative float, long durations, and resource overloads — then email you a professional audit report.

values.fieldLabel: Paste Schedule Data (XER Export / Activity List)
values.placeholder: Paste your exported schedule data here. You can export from P6: File > Export > Spreadsheet (XLS) then copy the activity table. Include columns: Activity ID, Activity Name, Duration, Start, Finish, Total Float, Predecessors, Resources. Or paste the raw XER text content.
Any specific areas you want the AI to focus on? e.g. 'Focus on commissioning phase' or 'We suspect resource overload in July'
